name: text-ribbon-banner
title: Headline Ribbon Wrap
description: Một dải màu bung từ giữa ra sau tiêu đề, chữ trồi lên trong dải, rồi hai đuôi ruy băng gấp lật ra hai bên như băng rôn.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-kinetic-type-headline-ribbon, written here): Band 200 × 36 px (radius 2) scaleX 0 → 1 from the centre 0.3–0.9 s expo.out. Text (18 px, paper colour) rises 22 px and fades in inside the band (clipped) 0.65–1.05 s power2.out. Tails unfold behind both band ends 1.05–1.5 s back.out(1.7): 44 px long, 9 px lower than the band, V-notch 12 px, 60 % opacity; fold triangle 14 px wide at 35 %. Exit: tails 3.25–3.5 s, text 3.4–3.6 s (power2.in), band 3.55–3.9 s expo.in. Loop 4.2 s. Params: dải (200 × 36 px) · đuôi (44 px, thấp 9 px) · thời gian bung (0.6 s). Markup: .rb-band holding .rb-text, and two .rb-tail (left, right) behind the band's ends.
